purpose: A bounded external soft-mixture pilot following the literature comparison; not a replication of Cu results or an internally trained sparse MoE.

data.roles: Frozen MACE weights never receive meta labels. The gate fits only the pre-existing meta-development role; grouped OOF is exploratory development. Validation60 was already used for MACE checkpoints and is not a new independent test. Prospective64+64 stays unopened.
data.cache: Reuse paired v0.8.0 prediction extxyz, checking numbers, coordinates, full reference energies/forces and exact frozen reaction identities against the original role HDF5.

objective.aggregation: Equal reactions; ten frames per reaction. Sum of squared per-atom absolute energy error and per-reaction mean Cartesian force error. Same weights mix energy and forces. No energy-only correction or learned energy offsets.

budget.inference: Every mixture evaluates all three frozen members. All member bytes and historical training are charged; no free general fallback or sparse-speed claim.

promotion: Require lower barrier MAE and non-worse global/TS force RMSE than fixed general512 in both grouped OOF and validation60, and a grouped OOF paired barrier CI upper bound below zero. Passing only permits further cost/search assessment; never automatically replaces the final model or opens prospective.
